texts.preamble: Guru Pado Thakur vs The State Of Jharkhand And Ors on 12 August, 2016 Author: Rongon Mukhopadhyay Bench: Rongon Mukhopadhyay In The High Court Of Jharkhand, Ranchi W.P. (Cr.) No. 116 of 2016 Guru Pado Thakur ... ... ... Petitioner Versus 1.The State of Jharkhand 2.The Secretary, Department of Health, Medical Education and Family Welfare, Govt. of Jharkhand, Ranchi 3.Deputy Commissioner cum Adjudicating Officer, Bokaro 4.Designated Officer cum Additional Chief Medical Officer, Bokaro 5.Food Safety Officer, Bokaro 6.Food Analyst for the State of Jharkhand, Ranchi, State Food and Drug Laboratory, Ranchi .. Respondents Coram: The Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rongon Mukhopadhyay ............ For the Petitioner : Mr. Mukesh Kumar For the Respondents : Mr. Vijayant Verma, J.C. to G.P. Ii 5/12.08.2016
texts.arguments: Mr. Mukesh Kumar, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner has submitted that Section 42 of the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 has not been properly followed as one of the sample which was taken by the Food Safety Officer was not given to the petitioner to be tested in an accredited laboratory. It is submitted that parameters with respect to the testing of the paneer which was analysed to be sub standard has not been followed. Mr. Vijayant Verma, learned J.C. to G.P. II seeks three weeks time to file counter-affidavit. List this case after three weeks.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Mr. Mukesh Kumar, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner has submitted that Section 42 of the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 has not been properly followed as one of the sample which was taken by the Food Safety Officer was not given to the petitioner to be tested in an accredited laboratory. It is submitted that parameters with respect to the testing of the paneer which was analysed to be sub standard has not been followed. Mr. Vijayant Verma, learned J.C. to G.P. II seeks three weeks time to file counter-affidavit. List this case after three weeks.
